title: Quick Australian Brie Stir Fry
description: A light and herbal Australian dish featuring brie cheese in a stir fry, perfect for a kid-friendly meal. This vegetarian-friendly recipe is easy to make and delicious to eat.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add the chopped bell pepper and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their moisture and start to brown, about 4 minutes.
Add the chopped snow peas and cook for 2 minutes, or until they are tender but still crisp.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the sliced brie cheese and stir until it is melted and well combined with the vegetables.
Season with dried thyme, salt, and pepper to taste.
Serve the stir fry hot over rice or noodles.
Garnish with additional thyme if desired.
